acceptanceCriteria: Fix lines emitted by `corvint dogfood change|check|seal` name the `corvint dogfood` subverb; the Makefile target is mentioned only when run through the Corvint Makefile, or not at all.
A test asserts the adopter wording.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the first complete Beamfall daily-path run (Beamfall scratch clone, change LCRES-15, BASE 0d7796be23efe4e2579408a5516b8aeff1a23008, bind 86fde0eb21d2e0fc41bfc06a4c06c9c3aef63e59; evidence retained in the session scratchpad beamfall-evidence/). In Beamfall, which has no Corvint Makefile targets, the not-complete fix lines from `corvint dogfood change` told the operator to rerun `make dogfood-change`. The adopter-facing command is `corvint dogfood change $BASE`.
title: dogfood: fix lines in an adopter repository say `rerun make dogfood-change` instead of `corvint dogfood change`
